guard: reserved describe retries inside the original deadline, retry publication failure settles cleanly, and resolved commands remain exactly one-shot
command: pnpm smoke:ep-invoke && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/core build && pnpm smoke:ep-rail-failure

mutations.name: describe returns to a one-shot publish, so a responder registering after it misses the whole request
mutations.expectRed: an unanswered describe is re-published within its original deadline when the responder registers after the first request

mutations.name: describe retry publication failure escapes its timer and becomes an uncaught exception
mutations.expectRed: a retry publish failure rejects the pending describe as unavailable and never escapes the timer

mutations.name: retry widens beyond reserved describe and re-publishes a caller-supplied resolved command
mutations.replace:
nc.publish(req.subject, req.body, { reply: noRespReplyTo });
    setTimeout(() => nc.publish(req.subject, req.body, { reply: noRespReplyTo }), 250);
mutations.expectRed: a resolved command is published exactly ONCE; describe readiness retry never widens to caller-supplied commands
